option_relations.rationale: Stiff skin syndrome is a broader term that may encompass various conditions, including segmental stiff skin syndrome.
Segmental stiff skin syndrome (SSS) is a specific condition that matches the description of the leaf with ID B3.2.
Linear Scleroderma (Morphea) is a distinct condition that does not match the description provided.
Congenital Fascial Dystrophy (Stiff Skin Syndrome) is another term that may be related to stiff skin syndrome, but it is not directly equivalent to any of the provided leaves.
